notes.title: A heartfelt thank you + what's next for Airport Manager
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone 👋[/p][p]I wanted to share a quick update with you all and say a huge thank you – [i]Airport Manager[/i] has now reached over [b]1,200 wishlists[/b]! That’s incredible, and seeing this much interest in the game honestly makes me both happy, super motivated, and excited for what’s ahead.[/p][p]Right now, I’m in the middle of [b]an 8-month military service[/b], which has made it difficult to work on the game lately. That said, my passion for the project hasn’t gone anywhere – I’m already looking forward to jumping back into development in [b]January[/b].[/p][p]I’m also looking forward to getting more involved with the community. To help with that, I’m working on setting up a [b]Discord server[/b] where I can stay in touch with you all and share updates and ideas. If [b]you[/b] want to follow the process more closely, that’ll be the place to be. I’ll also be looking for some help with development down the line – if that sounds interesting, I’d love to hear from you when the time comes![/p][p]I know it’s been quiet, but please know: [b]I’m coming back stronger than ever[/b]. Thanks so much for your patience and your support – it truly means everything.[/p]
